Truncates a non-ASCII body at a UTF-8 character boundary

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"max_body_size\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
```
